title: Sony Bank gets US regulator nod to issue stablecoins
summary: Sony Bank received preliminary approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a US stablecoin issuance business, with $40 million in starting capital.

title: Interpol operation exposes $122M crypto wallet tied to romance scam laundering
summary: Interpol said a suspect's crypto wallet processed over $122.5 million in 10 months as authorities uncovered the scheme during a global anti-fraud operation that led to 5,811 arrests.

title: Revolut says USDT delisting is limited to EEA, Switzerland
summary: Revolut said USDT support remains unchanged outside EEA and Switzerland as it winds down the stablecoin offering in selected European markets.

title: Hyperliquid shows how onchain perps could challenge Wall Street: Pantera
summary: Perpetual futures and Hyperliquid’s blockchain infrastructure are expanding into traditional asset classes with around-the-clock trading, according to Pantera Capital.

title: Bitcoin ETFs end 'most overwhelming' $2.7B sell-off amid new $85M net outflow
summary: Bitcoin spot ETFs posted a fresh net outflow on Wednesday as analysis said that their "most overwhelming" outflow streak had ended without a clear demand recovery.

title: Bank of Korea stands firm on bank-led stablecoin push as deposit token pilots advance
summary: The Bank of Korea reiterated its call for bank-led won stablecoin issuance while advancing deposit token pilots, as issuer rules remain a sticking point in South Korea’s digital asset bill.

title: SWIFT launches blockchain ledger with 17-bank tokenized deposit pilot
summary: SWIFT launched its new blockchain ledger that will host a tokenized bank deposit pilot for 17 major banks seeking faster cross-border payments.

title: Regulators invited Binance to seek new licenses after MiCA setback, co-CEO says
summary: Binance is exploring new licensing paths into Europe while continuing to expand its regulatory footprint in Asia, says co-CEO Richard Teng.

title: Russia's largest private bank Alfa-Bank tests crypto trading
summary: Alfa-Bank is testing cryptocurrency trading for qualified investors as Russia moves toward regulating digital assets and banks prepare new crypto services.

title: Wyden urges Senate leaders to keep dev protections in crypto bill
summary: Senator Ron Wyden has called on Senate leaders to ensure the Blockchain Regulatory Certainty Act remains in the CLARITY Act when it is brought to the floor.
